{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total rows:", len(df))
print("Duplicate patient_id count:", len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check how many rows have -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Confirm assay_batch B needs correction
print("Unique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())
print("Number of rows with assay_batch == 'B':", (df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum())"}
